description:
A sleek, high-performance DynamoDB desktop client

Dynamore is a fast, native DynamoDB desktop GUI client built with Rust and Tauri.
It supports AWS SSO / IAM Identity Center authentication, AWS Access Key / Secret Key authentication,
dynamic post-login region switching across 29 AWS regions, query and scan builders with secondary index (GSI & LSI) support,
form & JSON item editing, and table schema inspection.
